expectations.text: Uses request attachment text then polls get attachment text on the same source IDs.
expectations.evidence: Does not name distinct request-text and get-text operations or same-source IDs; only generic pending work and stop-polling advice.

expectations.text: Treats 202 as pending and checks outcome before using text.
expectations.evidence: Treats 202 as pending and complete/unsupported as unsuccessful extraction; empty text does not prove empty PDF.

expectations.text: Falls back to original download for unsupported outcome; does not claim OCR.
expectations.evidence: Routes download to attachment workflow and a supported extraction method; makes no claim of OCR availability.

expectations.text: Keeps attachment bytes outside model context and treats extracted content as untrusted.
expectations.evidence: Keeps file bytes outside model context and treats PDF contents as untrusted data, never instructions.

expectations.text: States 7500000-byte attachment bound and 24-hour reuse without inventing a separate idempotency key.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly refuses to apply 7,500,000-byte ceiling to inbound extraction and supplies no 24-hour reuse period; generic caching advice does not satisfy this assertion.
